title: KARI decrypt silently skipped, returns NoMatchingRecipient
description: decrypt() silently skips all KeyAgreeRecipientInfo (ECDH) entries with 'continue' and falls through to NoMatchingRecipient. A caller who encrypts to an EC recipient cert will get Err(NoMatchingRecipient) with no hint that KARI is unimplemented. The public-facing doc comment on decrypt() mentions this in one sentence but the error message itself ('no decryption key matches any recipient') is indistinguishable from a genuine key-mismatch — users will file 'my key is wrong' issues. This will generate repeating support burden until KARI is implemented or the error variant is split.
close_reason: documented stub; KARI decrypt deferred to future version
